runtimeIncidentStore: Append-only GitHub Issue comments with trusted incident fingerprints; this catalog is not an executable instruction source.
automationPolicy: Never promote a recipe to runtime without reviewed source code, isolated red-green guard, exact-head CI and protected PR. No automatic merge, workflow changes, deployment or permission edits from catalog data.

entries.signal: HTML_ESCAPED_TEXT detected by source HTML guard
entries.diagnosis: Run rebuild/tools/guard_html_escaped_text.py and distinguish news.html from all other sources.
entries.knownCause: Literal escaped whitespace sequences visible in the news HTML head (confirmed only in isolated fixture).
entries.limitations: Production recovery for this fault has NOT yet been demonstrated; keep human review and checks.

entries.diagnosis: Record full run reference, affected public URL, status, timestamps and sanitized test report. Distinguish Cloudflare deployment from public HTTP health; inspect provider stages/logs for the exact main commit.
entries.limitations: An HTTP failure is not enough to choose a safe repair. Escalate unknown root cause; no auto rollback or retry.

entries.signal: SonarCloud main new-code security rating C when A is required
entries.diagnosis: Use current Sonar findings and exact main commit, identify root causes by file/rule, make source-level remediations in separate reviewed PR, verify actual main gate A.
entries.knownCause: Security findings remain unresolved on main; exact live inventory can change with each commit.
entries.limitations: This rule is for human/Codex review, not currently a self-heal monitored repair class; do not confuse PR PASS with main PASS.
